thread:
pagerduty: SEV2 — auth-service: high rate of JWT validation failures in prod. page fired to @oncall (urgent) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2248901234 — auth.jwt.validation.errors > 5% (5m) — PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC-2248901234
Sam Patel: oncall here, acknowledging. pulling logs now.
Priya Rao: seeing spike in 401s to /v1/auth/validate from our mobile frontends, starts ~2026-07-14T22:07:00Z. lots of "kid not found" in auth-service logs.
Sam Patel: copying a couple of log lines:
```
2026-07-14T22:07:12Z auth-service ERROR token_validation.go:143 kid not found: kid="k_2026_07_14_b" token=eyJhbGci...
2026-07-14T22:07:13Z auth-service WARN jwks_cache.go:52 failed fetch jwks: 502 Bad Gateway
```
Priya Rao: jwks endpoint (https://auth.example/.well-known/jwks.json) returning the old set; new rotating key doesn't appear. suspect rotation rollover didn't publish the new public key.
Clara Gomez: was there a scheduled key rotation today?
Sam Patel: yes, automated rotation kicked at 22:00 UTC for tenant-default signer (per weekly rotate cron). we've had 3 successful rotations previously.
Daniel Kim: if the private key flipped but JWKS didn't update, tokens signed with new kid fail validation -> client tokens minted after rotation will 401. we need to check key distributor job and CDN cache.
Sam Patel: running quick checks: curl output from edge (us-east-1):
```
$ curl -sS https://auth.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
"k_2026_07_14_a"
"k_2026_06_07_x"
```
Sam Patel: new kid k_2026_07_14_b missing.
Priya Rao: checking distributor logs: key-service posted new key to key-store at 22:00:01, but key-distributor job shows error 504 when pushing to jwks-publisher at 22:00:03.
incident-bot: key-distributor job failed x3, last exit code 504. logs: https://logs.example/job/key-distributor/2248901203
Sam Patel: possible CDN cache at edge retained old JWKS. but curl from edge shows missing kid, so publisher likely never updated origin.
Clara Gomez: impact assessment — preliminary: ~14% of production requests to protected APIs are getting 401s (mobile web + mobile native), affecting sessions minted in the 22:00-22:07 window. Payment flows impacted for a subset of users.
support-bot: creating support incident and emailing top 10 affected customers. ticket created: SUP-2248901.
Daniel Kim: mitigation options:
- A) Re-publish new public key to JWKS (fix publisher) — fastest if publisher can be retried.
- B) Rollback signer to previous key via feature flag so newly minted tokens use old kid (requires coordinating token issuers).
- C) Short-lived emergency fallback: allow auth-service to accept both kids by loading private key for new kid temporarily (security tradeoff).
Sam Patel: trying option A first — re-run publisher push with --force, and tail publisher logs.
Priya Rao: re-run command: `kubectl -n infra exec job/key-distributor -- /bin/distributor --push-jwks --tenant=default --force`
Sam Patel: distributor now returning 200 and publisher reports success. waiting for JWKS propagation.
Sam Patel: curl again:
```
$ curl -sS https://auth.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
"k_2026_07_14_b"
"k_2026_07_14_a"
"k_2026_06_07_x"
```
Sam Patel: new kid present at origin.
Priya Rao: clearing CDN edge caches (fastly purge) and invalidating internal jwks caches: `POST https://cdn.fastly/purge/auth.example` and run redis flush for `jwks_cache:*`
Sam Patel: issuing fastly purge now. also running `redis-cli -h redis-prod del $(redis-cli -h redis-prod keys "jwks_cache:*")` (will be cautious).
Clara Gomez: metrics look good — 401 rate dropping back toward baseline.
Daniel Kim: paging status?
pagerduty: INC-2248901234 acknowledged by Sam Patel at 22:09 UTC. Escalation to SRE oncall level 2 (Clara Gomez) at 22:12 UTC.
Sam Patel: confirming customer impact window: 22:00:01 — 22:09:30 UTC. peak 14% 401s. mitigation: republished JWKS + CDN purge + cache invalidation.
Priya Rao: follow-ups:
- add retry logic and alert on key-distributor 5xxs
- increase visibility: dashboard for jwks sync latency and last-success time
- add smoke test that validates JWKS contains expected new kid immediately after rotation
Sam Patel: creating ticket for postmortem: PM-224890. assigning owners: Priya -> root cause & mitigation code, Daniel -> runbook updates, Clara -> customer comms + SLA impact calc.
Clara Gomez: sending notification to affected customers + ops notification channel. drafting status update now.
Daniel Kim: handing off to night oncall (Daniel Kim) — I will monitor for 2 hours and ensure no regression. leaving runbook link: https://docs.example/runbooks/jwks-rotation
Sam Patel: thanks team — closing pagerduty once monitoring looks stable. add any missing notes in PM-224890.
pagerduty: INC-2248901234 resolved by Sam Patel at 22:20 UTC — resolution summary: key-distributor transient 504 prevented JWKS publish; republish + CDN cache purge resolved validation failures.
Clara Gomez: postmortem owners noted, will schedule RCA sync tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: support ticket SUP-2248901 updated with final impact window and mitigation steps.
Priya Rao: small note — we should throttle rotation job concurrency during heavy traffic windows. adding to follow-up.
Daniel Kim: leaving TL;DR for next oncall: "Transient failure in key distributor caused new signing key to not appear in JWKS; republished and purged caches; verify JWKS contains new kid and watchers. Monitor 401 rate for 24h."
Sam Patel: logging final timeline to the incident doc and closing this slack thread.
